synthetic_articulated_gaussians.description: Runnable lightweight two-state articulated Gaussian benchmark for the core SPLART claim. Thresholds follow the paper's success criteria: low articulation axis/amount/pivot error, correct part decomposition, and geometric consistency.

quality_score.description: Continuous joint score combining articulation-axis error, motion-amount error, pivot error, part IoU, and reconstruction Chamfer; used as the train/test ranking metric because binary success saturates on the current reproduction.

success.description: Binary success under the benchmark thresholds for articulation, part decomposition, and geometry.

axis_error_deg.description: Angular error between predicted and ground-truth articulation axes in degrees.

amount_error.description: Motion amount error, using translation-vector error for prismatic scenes and angle error for revolute scenes.

pivot_error.description: Distance from the predicted revolute pivot to the ground-truth articulation axis; zero for prismatic scenes.

mean_part_iou.description: Mean IoU over static and mobile part assignments after thresholding the predicted mobility probabilities.

mobile_iou.description: IoU for the mobile part assignment, catching all-static shortcuts.

static_iou.description: IoU for the static part assignment, catching all-mobile shortcuts.

reconstruction_chamfer.description: Opacity-weighted two-state reconstruction Chamfer distance under the predicted articulation.

worst_part_iou.description: Lower of mobile and static IoU, so a method cannot hide a failed part behind the mean.

mobility_brier.description: Brier score for soft mobility probabilities against ground-truth static/mobile labels.

state_mobility_disagreement.description: Mean absolute disagreement between the two state-specific mobility predictions for the same Gaussian.

paper_paris_pms_articulation_reconstruct.description: Paper Table 1, PARIS-PMS overall articulation and mesh reconstruction metrics.

axis_error_x1e2_deg.description: Published articulation-axis error in degrees scaled by 1e2, reported as an error to minimize.

pivot_error_x1e3.description: Published pivot-location error scaled by 1e3, reported as an error to minimize.

rotation_error_x1e2_deg.description: Published rotation-amount error in degrees scaled by 1e2, reported as an error to minimize.

translation_error_x1e3.description: Published translation-amount error scaled by 1e3, reported as an error to minimize.

static_cd_x1e3.description: Published static-part Chamfer distance scaled by 1e3, reported as an error to minimize.

mobile_cd_x1e3.description: Published mobile-part Chamfer distance scaled by 1e3, reported as an error to minimize.

whole_cd_x1e3.description: Published whole-object Chamfer distance scaled by 1e3, reported as an error to minimize.
